schema.title: The Scrum Guide (2020)
schema.description: A Scrum Team and its artifacts, as the 2020 Scrum Guide defines them.

Accountability.description: Scrum defines three specific accountabilities within the Scrum Team: the Developers, the Product Owner, and the Scrum Master.

ScrumEvent.description: The Sprint is a container for all other events: Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review and Sprint Retrospective.

ScrumArtifact.description: Scrum's artifacts: Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog and Increment.

Commitment.description: Each artifact contains a commitment: for the Product Backlog it is the Product Goal, for the Sprint Backlog the Sprint Goal, for the Increment the Definition of Done.

ScrumValue.description: Five values: Commitment, Focus, Openness, Respect, and Courage.

Pillar.description: The empirical Scrum pillars of transparency, inspection, and adaptation.

ProductBacklog.description: An emergent, ordered list of what is needed to improve the product. Its commitment is the Product Goal.

productGoal.description: The Product Goal describes a future state of the product.

SprintBacklog.description: Composed of the Sprint Goal (why), the set of Product Backlog items selected for the Sprint (what), as well as an actionable plan for delivering the Increment (how).

sprintGoal.description: The single objective for the Sprint.

selectedItems.description: The Product Backlog items selected for the Sprint.

plan.description: An actionable plan for delivering the Increment.

Increment.description: A concrete stepping stone toward the Product Goal. Its commitment is the Definition of Done.

definitionOfDone.description: A formal description of the state of the Increment when it meets the quality measures required for the product.

scrumMaster.description: The Scrum Team consists of one Scrum Master,
